cases.name: fresh_clean
cases.note: observed two hours ago against a one day bound; the only case whose clean answer speaks to the present

cases.name: stale_clean
cases.note: same registry, one hour bound; two hours old is outside it, so the clean answer says nothing about revocations since

cases.name: undated_clean
cases.note: no observation instant, so there is no basis on which to call the clean answer current however generous the bound

cases.name: unbounded_clean
cases.note: registry is dated but the deployment stated no bound; Section 10 puts that parameter on the deployment, so absent it the answer is unknown

cases.name: revoked_fresh
cases.note: revoked in time and the registry is fresh; revoked, and a revoked verdict never establishes current validity either

cases.name: revoked_stale
cases.note: THE ASYMMETRY. The registry is a month stale and the receipt is still revoked, because a revocation fact does not expire. Staleness weakens only the negative answer

cases.name: future_as_of
cases.note: observed after now, so the two clocks disagree and the bound cannot be evaluated honestly; unknown rather than trivially fresh
